_doc: Manual, documented selection of the k-21.dxf IfcWall pieces (by a point inside each piece, ITM) that make up the pool, the pool-cover channel and the machine room / balance tank. Chosen visually on K-400 / K-21 (pool between piles 28-31; cover channel = the narrow box on the pool's east side; machine room + balance tank = the two cells south of the pool around pile 32). Used by tools/extract_pool.py.
source: sources/structure/k-21.dxf (IfcWall HATCH); verified against sources/structure/K-400-תכנית יסודות.pdf
